title: DUKTIG 14-piece vegetables set
description: DUKTIG 14-piece vegetables set Play is a fun way to learn about the colors, shapes and names of different vegetables. These are made of a soft material and are easy to wash, so your child can be just as creative as a master chef. Helps the child develop fine motor skills and hand/eye co-ordination.
features: Includes: 1 vegetable box with 2 mushrooms, 2 tomatoes, 1 onion, 1 leek, 1 cucumber, 1 bundle of carrots, 1 head of lettuce and 4 salad leaves.
In the DUKTIG series, there is everything that a little chef needs to succeed in the kitchen.
